description: This Dart source file defines the GameState class which manages the state, game logic, and persistence for a Tic Tac Toe game in a Flutter app. It handles the game board, player turns, score tracking, winner detection, and local storage using shared_preferences.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Central state management class for Tic Tac Toe game, handling game logic, score persistence, and notifying UI about state changes.

methods.name: GameState
methods.description: Constructor that initializes game state and loads persisted scores from local storage.

methods.name: _loadScores
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the saved scores for players X and O from shared preferences.

methods.name: _persistScores
methods.description: Saves the current scores for X and O into shared preferences.

methods.name: playMove
methods.description: Handles a player's move at a specific board index, updates game state, and checks for win or draw.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board for a new round without affecting scores.

methods.name: resetScores
methods.description: Resets the scores for both players and clears the game board.

methods.name: detectWinner
methods.description: Detects if there is a winner and updates the game state accordingly.

methods.name: detectDraw
methods.description: Detects if the game has ended in a draw.

methods.name: _detectWinner
methods.description: Performs the winner detection based on predefined winning patterns.

methods.name: _detectDraw
methods.description: Checks if all moves have been played without a winner, indicating a draw.
